exposure: advanced maternal age (35 years and above)
outcome: mode of delivery (Caesarean section, instrumental delivery)
cohort: Antenatal women aged 35 years or older delivering at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, Gandhi Medical College, Bhopal between January 1, 2021 and July 31, 2022.
finding: Women of advanced maternal age (35+ years) experience a higher risk of various complications including anemia, hypertension, caesarean section, postpartum hemorrhage, stillbirth, and low birth weight infants.
mod_finding: 153 (28.3%) participants underwent caesarean section, and 9 (1.7%) had instrumental delivery, with fetal distress and previous caesarean section being the most common indications for caesarean section.
